_comment: Locked study settings. Every value marked PROVISIONAL needs team sign-off (docs/DECISION_LOG.md). Change values here, never in code.

randomization._comment: Seeds copied from workbook Settings!B8:B9. The algorithm in oe/schedule.py reproduces the workbook Run Log exactly (verified).

prompt._comment_active_version: PROVISIONAL (D3). P1-standardized = 2026 PS+ prefix (minus 'title and') + case text + stem + options + answer-format line. P0-natural is a documented candidate, not an arm.
prompt._comment_image_arm_option: A = substitution (decided in workbook README). B = additive (would be a new design; needs approval).
prompt._comment_source_exclusion: PROVISIONAL (D2). OFF: not in any 2026 prompt and it tells the model the case is a JAMA Clinical Challenge. Wording stored in prompt version file.
prompt._comment_answer_format: PROVISIONAL (D4). Required by methodology for blinded grading; new relative to 2026.

grading._comment: Per methodology, MULTIPLE or NONE is scored incorrect (0) after a grader has read the full response. An unparseable answer-format line alone is never scored.

collection._comment: pending = scheduled run with no attempt row. Analysis uses the FIRST attempt with status 'completed'; failed attempts are kept for audit.

analysis._comment_subspecialty: PROVISIONAL (D9). Subspecialties with < 20 eligible cases are pooled into one covariate level for the regression only; descriptive tables keep every subspecialty.

historical_2026._comment: Historical results from the 2026 study (single earlier model, text only). Descriptive comparison only. NEVER copied into new outcome fields.
historical_2026.label: 2026 study (earlier OpenEvidence model, text only; historical, not part of this study)
